p1.title: International Mobility
p1.desc1: International mobility offers students the opportunity to broaden their academic and cultural horizons through study or collaboration experiences abroad.
p1.desc2: With a strong network of international academic partners, EBS students have the opportunity to begin their studies in Tunisia and complete them at a partner international institution.

p2.title: Technologies & Certifications
p2.desc1: The integration of emerging technologies is a central element of our training programs. AI is now a cross-cutting skill in all our courses.
p2.desc2: Academic pathways are enriched by recognized certifications, allowing students to validate practical skills in high value-added fields and strengthen the employability and adaptability of graduates.

p3.title: Economic Partners
p3.desc1: Our partnerships with economic players strengthen the link between academic training and the realities of the professional world. These collaborations promote internships, applied projects, expert interventions, and employment opportunities.
p3.desc2: By working alongside leading companies and organizations, EBS develops training programs in line with market skills and challenges.

s1.title: AI as a mandatory skill in all our programs
s1.desc: For the 2025/2026 academic year, artificial intelligence will be integrated as an essential skill in all our programs, regardless of the chosen specialty. Students develop an understanding of AI tools, uses, and challenges to make it a lever for analysis, innovation, and performance. This approach prepares graduates capable of evolving in an environment where artificial intelligence is progressively transforming professions and organizations.

s2.title: Integration of 150+ International Certifications in our various programs
s2.desc: EBS integrates over 150 recognized international certifications into its various training programs to strengthen academic skills through concrete professional validations. These certifications cover various fields such as management, finance, marketing, artificial intelligence, project management, cybersecurity, and digital technologies. This approach allows students to enrich their profiles, highlight their achievements, and prepare for international market standards and requirements.

s3.title: 2025-2026 Registrations Open — Early Bird Discounts until June 30
s3.desc: Applications for the 2025-2026 academic year are now open for all our bachelor's, master's, and specialized training programs. Take advantage of our Early Bird discounts, up to 25% off your tuition fees, by finalizing your registration before June 30, and prepare your academic journey today in an environment focused on innovation, technologies, and tomorrow's skills. Our teaching and administrative teams are at your disposal to support you in choosing the training best suited to your academic and professional project.

about.title: Join the Business School
about.desc: Espima Business School evolves its programs with one ultimate goal: to allow each student to build a more competitive profile, better prepared for the demands of the job market.
about.f1Desc: At EBS, every student - regardless of their field - masters the AI tools most demanded by recruiters. From management bachelor's to financial engineering master's. It's not an option: it's our commitment to your employability.
about.f2Desc: In addition to your degree recognized by the Tunisian state, you leave with certifications issued by the most recognized organizations in the world. Free. Included in your training. Valued anywhere in the world.
